name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd
title: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd - 544367 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 1,007 crores (+157%) and order book above INR 1,400 crores, but supply is the binding constraint: insulators at 18–24 month lead times and capacity arriving only from July–December 2026, so FY27 growth guided at 15–20%.

capex.quote: Our new factory is expected to commence operations around July-August 2026

triggers.label: Sangli capacity slips to Aug 2026
triggers.quote: Our new factory is expected to commence operations around July-August 2026

triggers.label: Insulator lead times 18–24 months
triggers.quote: there are insulators where the deliveries are already going 18 to 24 months

triggers.label: Q1–Q2 margin hit from input costs
triggers.quote: I believe Q1, Q2 can be hit.

triggers.label: Q4 order inflow INR 870 crores
triggers.quote: the order inflow, I stand corrected, is about INR 870 crores last quarter

guidance.metric: FY27 order book target before FY28
guidance.quote: we should be targeting at least INR 1,500 crores to INR 1,800 crores of order book before the start of next year
July end, August is what we are guiding in.

prior_guidance_check.quote: closed the year at a consolidated revenue of INR 1,007 crores
a full-year EBITDA margin of 23.5%, comfortably above the revised guidance

red_flags.label: Insulator supply bottleneck delaying projects
red_flags.quote: some of our projects are getting hurt because of some critical components

red_flags.label: Ind AS 29 monetary loss INR 25.7 crore in Q4
red_flags.quote: this restatement has resulted in a net monetary loss of approximately INR 25.7 crores

red_flags.label: Promoter fundraise enabler USD 75 million
red_flags.quote: The board has also approved an enabling authorization to raise up to USD 75 million

evasions.quote: I'm sure the board is also deciding something on the insulator side of the thing. As and when is the right time, we will let the markets know.
Very difficult to quantify that way, sir
Sir, we don't have those data available offhand.
